subject.title: model-selection: duplicate model aliases silently overwrite each other

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the shipped last-match selected provider/model while warning, or may OpenClaw intentionally switch duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning is a bounded repair, but changing which duplicate alias wins can alter provider/model routing for existing configs, so maintainer product and compatibility intent is required before a fix lands.

options.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
options.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model as the effective selection, emit a clear duplicate warning, and cover alias-index callers too.

options.title: Approve First-Match Precedence
options.body: Accept first-match behavior as an intentional compatibility break only with upgrade proof and release-note context.

options.title: Use One Unified Replacement
options.body: Pause overlapping PRs and land a single narrow fix that covers both resolver paths after the precedence decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve Shipped Winner While Warning
recommendation.body: Keep the current last matching provider/model as the effective selection, emit a clear duplicate warning, and cover alias-index callers too.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the alias feature and later moved this behavior into the shared model-selection helper.
